# Adversarial cases — written to break the design, not to confirm it.
# The asymmetry under test: the deny scan reads the RAW command (so it sees
# inside quotes and substitutions), the allow scan reads the MASKED command
# (so it can never be talked into allowing). Anything unprovable must defer.
# danger smuggled inside a double-quoted substitution (masking must not hide it)
# danger smuggled inside the new shell-construct handling
